text: Brian Lara holds the record for the highest individual score in Test cricket: 400 not out against England in Antigua in 2004.
Sachin Tendulkar's highest Test score was 248 not out, against Bangladesh in Dhaka in 2004.
Sachin Tendulkar scored 15,921 runs in Test cricket, the most by any player.
Sachin Tendulkar is the only player to have scored 100 international centuries. He reached the milestone in March 2012.
Don Bradman finished his Test career with a batting average of 99.94.
Viv Richards' highest Test score was 291, against England at The Oval in 1976.
Sri Lanka beat Pakistan in the final of the 2022 Asia Cup, played in Dubai.
The 2022 Asia Cup was played in the T20 format. India were knocked out in the Super Four stage and did not reach the final.
Virat Kohli scored 122 not out against Afghanistan at the 2022 Asia Cup. It was his first century in T20 internationals and his 71st international century.
Virat Kohli scored 82 not out against Pakistan at the Melbourne Cricket Ground in the 2022 T20 World Cup, guiding India to a four-wicket win.
MS Dhoni captained India to victory in the 2011 Cricket World Cup.
Rohit Sharma captained India in T20 internationals during 2022.
New Zealand beat India by 18 runs in the 2019 Cricket World Cup semi-final at Old Trafford, Manchester.
Java 8 introduced lambda expressions and the Streams API.
Optional is a Java class that may or may not hold a value. It helps avoid NullPointerException.
Spring Boot uses auto-configuration and an embedded web server, so an application can run as a single executable JAR.
A REST API exposes resources over HTTP using methods such as GET, POST, PUT and DELETE.
JUnit is a widely used framework for unit testing Java code.
Maven and Gradle are build tools that manage dependencies and build Java projects.
Hibernate is an object-relational mapping (ORM) framework that maps Java classes to database tables.
The Java Virtual Machine (JVM) runs compiled bytecode, so the same Java program can run on different operating systems.
Error code E-4012 means the payment was declined by the bank. Ask the customer to contact their bank or use another card.
Error code E-4013 means the card has expired. Ask the customer to update their card details.
Error code E-4021 means the billing address does not match the card. Ask the customer to check the address.
Error code E-5001 means the payment service is temporarily unavailable. Ask the customer to try again in a few minutes.
To reset a password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the link sent by email.
An account is locked for 30 minutes after five failed login attempts.
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 10 working days.
Customers can change their email address in Account Settings, under Profile.
Roast vegetables at about 200°C for 30 to 40 minutes, turning them halfway through.
Toast cumin seeds in a dry pan for about a minute to release their aroma.
Turmeric gives curries their yellow colour.
Rinse basmati rice until the water runs clear before cooking it.
Season vegetables with salt and pepper before roasting.
Onions soften in about 5 to 8 minutes over a medium heat.
The heat in chillies comes mainly from a compound called capsaicin.
Rest meat for a few minutes after cooking so it stays juicy.
